title: Bluetti Apex 300 Power Station 3,840W 2,764.8Wh & Bonus Foldable Trolley (Worth $499) for $2,819.06 Shipped @ Bluetti AU
body:
Deal: Bluetti Apex 300 Power Station 3,840W 2,764.8Wh & Bonus Foldable Trolley (Worth $499) for $2,819.06 Shipped @ Bluetti AU

[shane2770] Tell em the price son
Okay edited beat me
[Deepchild] waiting for sodium batteries to tank the market then ill buy a power station.
[StonedWizard] @Deepchild - Downside is lower energy density, weight and size.
[King Tightarse] $500 for a folding trolley shows the built in butt reaming in the price
[Vorsprungdurchtech] Can this charge my EV 2-3% in an emergency using a normal 10A granny charger?
[Sleepycat3] You can even use a 15A granny charger with this.
[SoylentGreen] How do these catch on to hotcopperites without eneloop power equivalency?
[Sleepycat3] This has the same capacity as 1152 Eneloops, and has a built in inverter to convert the battery voltage to 230V for use at home.
[King Tightarse] We can buy this https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/965923 4000Wh with expansion battery for $1798. That's 45c per Wh.
Your deal is more than double price at $1.02 Wh. Terrible value!
[Tanvry] yeah at this point it costs about the same as a Tesla powerwall installed, not worth it at all
[adam149] Hi Bluetti, I can review this for you and post my review/images on enthusiast solar and battery forums. This will be far more powerful and have more reach. Feel free to reach out.
